letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow we share, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. Today, as the calendar turns another page, I find myself falling even deeper for my cutie—your smile is my compass, your laughter my favorite song. Whether we’re strolling the dunes or sipping chai on a rainy balcony, my heart beats only for you. Thank you for making every moment a beautiful adventure; I love you more than words can capture.
poem:
In Dubai’s heat or Ahmedabad’s rain,  
Your love’s the rhythm that steadies my train.  
Cutie, you’re my sunrise, my moonlit glow,  
Together forever, wherever we go.
